premises.text: African haulage lacks centralized coordination and flexibility, so contracted trucks no-show and transporters stay idle most of the time
premises.evidence_span: there's no flexibility or centralized coordination in the system

premises.text: A tech-enabled logistics platform collects journey data and redirects trucks with data-driven decisions throughout loading, transit, and offloading
premises.evidence_span: tech-enabled logistics optimization solution that provides this flexibility and centralized coordination

premises.text: Dashboards and live tracking give cargo owners and transporters visibility and peace of mind
premises.evidence_span: providing our car owners with further visibility through dashboards and tracking mechanisms

premises.text: Focus is long-haul commodity moves such as grains, fertilizers, cement, and sugar across Sub-Saharan Africa
premises.evidence_span: Right now we're focused on grains, fertilizers, cement, and sugar

value.text: Lower cost of goods in Africa by fixing long-haul logistics coordination
value.evidence_span: bringing down the cost of goods for all of us and for the whole continent

causal_links.evidence_span: Lorry is moving large volumes across Sub-Saharan Africa

notes: Cargo-owner no-shows, trucker idle time, and loading delays kept as one coordination pain set. Redirection examples and data-point collection folded into optimization mechanism; visibility kept as related but distinct customer-facing module. Run-rate and retention figures excluded as traction. Waze partnership treated as tracking detail inside P3.
